leadText:
The Pokémon Sled Jump master, or simply the Pokémon Sled master (Japanese: ジャンプ名人 Jump Master) is a character of the day who appeared in Getting a Jump on the Competition!. 

He is the prize maker and one of the hosts for the Pokémon Sled Jump Games on Mount Lanakila.

Whenever he is judging the competitors on their performances, he would often comment on doing a similar performance whilst giving an ever increasing number of years on when he did it.

==Voice actors==
 

==Trivia==
The Pokémon Sled Jump master, master caddy, and the master fisherman all share the same Japanese voice actor. The Sled Jump master and the master fisherman also share the same English and voice actors.
